Putnam Fl Investment Management Co increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 1.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Putnam Fl Investment Management Co bought 2,710 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 247,139 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $41.82M, up from 244,429 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Putnam Fl Investment Management Co who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $924.83B market cap company. The stock increased 0.99% or $1.85 during the last trading session, reaching $188.16. About 11.72M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
